0b9d1d24: ;
 ;DGJPAR1 routine - This routine performs following functions:
 ;1. Displays the 'ENTER/EDIT DEFINITION PARAMETERS' option on the user's screen.
 ;2. Handles user's input and validates the data entered.
 ;3. Stores the user's input in temporary global arrays for further processing.
 ;4. Initializes various variables and counters used in the routine.
0d807ba9: ;Calls the ENTER/EDIT DEFINITION PARAMETERS option and displays its contents on the user's screen.
23042fb4: ;Exits the routine if the user does not wish to proceed further.

d4103942: ;Initializes various temporary global arrays and variables used in the routine, such as DGJCAT (Category counter), VALMCNT (Screen line counter), DGJCNT and DGJCNT1 (Other counters), DGJTFG and DGJTFLG (Flags), and DGJTSR1 (Starting index for the List Manager).
20c6c1e2: ;Sets the initial values for DGJNAME (Name counter) and DGJTUP (Update flag).
2cd65011: Process utilities for an Institution Code
429469e3: If there are no utility codes, display a message indicating that none were found.
0f58ce2e: Display message that highlighted text is uneditable and enter '??' for help
ba9a058b: Quit/Exit the routine
22c587a2: Loop through entries in ^TMP global. If IFN exists in VISIT file #393.3, call SETG1 routine
86bab388: Quit/Exit the routine
d76b6e54: This line sets (kills) all the variables used in the routine by assigning them a null value.
25bdccf5: This line kills (sets to null value) additional variables used in the routine, as well as some temporary global arrays.

5f24cb3d: ;Set VALMBCK to null initially

bbfc10be: ;If user entered '^^' to quit, kill the array and go to 'REP'.
b1784f67: ;Set 'VALMBCK' to 'R' to refresh the screen and quit.

a720c334: ;If the 9th piece of the 0th node is 1 (indicating it's a text parameter), write the 1st piece (parameter name) and then edit the 7th and 8th pieces (parameter text). Otherwise, edit using the 'DGJ DEF PARAMETER EDIT' input template. If the user entered '^^' to quit, don't continue.
